audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is scored Cho'Gath 7/10 in both layers, but the packet chart says Skill and both prose fields call it an even CS race ('Even farming start', 'Both are weak at level 1... a fair CS race').
audit.why: Cho'Gath has no Rupture at level 1 and Kayle has no range yet — neither kit threatens the other. The rest of the chart (Kayle from 3, Cho'Gath at 6, Kayle from first item) matches the prose and the 46.5% headline over 314 games.
audit.corrected: Level 1 flips to Skill, rating 5/10. No other row changes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment is named as the tracked cooldown in ten fields and its actual number is never given, so 'engage on its cooldown' is unactionable.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80 seconds. At level 6 that is 160 seconds — the longest cooldown in the lane by a wide margin, and far longer than Feast at 80s. Baiting it once at 6 gives Cho'Gath a window measured in minutes, which is the single most useful number in this matchup. Kayle's real spike is level 11 plus two items, which the content layer states correctly.
audit.corrected: Put 160s at rank 1 into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated anywhere: Feral Scream silences, and a silenced Kayle cannot cast Divine Judgment. 'Key Ability Interactions' says only 'bait it'. The layer also never names Radiant Blast, Celestial Blessing or Starfire Spellblade (packet defect confirms this).
audit.why: Feast is a point-blank true-damage execute at 175 range; Divine Judgment makes its target invulnerable, so Feast lands for nothing through it. Silencing her before she can cast is the only reliable answer Cho'Gath owns. Radiant Blast additionally reduces resistances on hit, which is why armour stacking reads the trade wrong. Starfire Spellblade is an auto-attack reset that costs no mana — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: State the silence-blocks-Divine-Judgment interaction in report[5], and name Radiant Blast's resistance shred and Celestial Blessing's 15s heal in cooldowns and itemization.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind' — wrong pronoun, and it never names the heal it is countering.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15-second heal at every rank; that is the Grievous Wounds target the missing-interactions file flags for this matchup. Naming Bramble Vest and the 15s number makes the timing concrete.
audit.corrected: Name Bramble Vest and Celestial Blessing's 15s cadence.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Common Mistakes entries have descriptions copied from a different matchup: 'Fall behind in scaling' is explained as 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown', which describes nothing on this page. Kayle is also referred to as 'he'/'his' in several fields.
audit.why: A description that does not match its own heading is worse than no description — the reader cannot tell which advice belongs to which mistake.
audit.corrected: Rewrite dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d to match their headings.

notes: The packet defect 'never names any of Kayle's abilities' is real and I fixed the highest-value instances rather than all of them, because the +-10% length band leaves no room to insert 'Starfire Spellblade' (20 chars) into short strings. FLAG MISFIRE: the kit tags Divine Judgment 'untargetable', but Riot's description says it makes the target invulnerable — different mechanic. I wrote 'invulnerable' throughout; an 'untargetable' claim would wrongly tell the player Feast cannot be cast at all, when it can, it just deals nothing. Level chart: only the Level 1 row flips (to Skill), proposed in both layers together.
